| `orientation?` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | Explicit layout axis for before/after drop-position and sortable-index calculation. When unset, falls back to measuring `getBoundingClientRect().width > height` — a heuristic that can misjudge square-ish zones, short vertical lists in wide containers, or wrapping layouts. Set this explicitly whenever the dropzone's aspect ratio doesn't reliably reflect its scroll/item axis. |
